items.t: Coca Cola Consolidated (COKE) Stock Looks Expensive As Its 269% Five Year Run Continues
items.sum: Coca-Cola Consolidated has delivered a powerful run over the past few years, so the obvious question now is whether the current share price lines up with the cash it can generate. With the stock closing at US$210.12 most recently, the issue is how that market value stacks up against the stream of cash flows investors are paying for.
